criterion: flag a val document when some train document covers >= 0.5 of its characters with non-template windows (>= min(3, n_windows) distinct hashes), or reproduces >= 0.98 of it verbatim
reason_not_jaccard: Jaccard>=0.8 misses containment leaks (a short val document copied into one paragraph of a long train document has tiny Jaccard but total containment)
reason_not_window_count: a bare shared-window count fires on shared boilerplate prefixes and removed English documents 6x more often than Chinese ones, biasing the very BPB the study measures
